claims.text: Masked Document Generation (MDG) is a task that learns to recover a document with a masked span of tokens.
In MDG, a continuous sub-sequence of tokens in a document is masked, and the model predicts the original text from the remaining tokens.
MDG is one of the three pre-training tasks designed for sequence-to-sequence models, alongside Sentence Reordering and Next Sentence Generation.
